name: problem-advisor
description: A problem advisor that locates what is actually stuck before answering, then applies the single thinking tool that could change the conclusion. Covers decision trade-offs, learning bottlenecks and organizational friction.

displayDescription.en: Locates what is actually stuck, then picks the one thinking tool that could change the conclusion. Usually delivers only judgment, evidence and a next step.
displayDescription.zh: 先判断真正卡住的是什么，再从一百个思维工具中挑出能改变结论的那一个。通常只给判断、依据和下一步。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我在两个方向之间反复摇摆，帮我理清该看什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: I keep swinging between two directions — help me see what actually matters

quickPrompts.en: I keep swinging between two directions — help me see what actually matters
quickPrompts.zh: 我在两个方向之间反复摇摆，帮我理清该看什么

quickPrompts.en: My child understands it in class but can't do it alone — where is the gap?
quickPrompts.zh: 孩子上课能听懂，自己做就不行，问题出在哪

quickPrompts.en: My team keeps missing execution — is it the people or the system?
quickPrompts.zh: 团队执行不到位，是人的问题还是机制问题
